intro.title: Build typed design tokens model
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a typed design tokens model using TypeScript. Design tokens are reusable values like colors, spacing, and typography that define a design system. You will learn to use TypeScript's core concepts of interfaces and types to create a strongly-typed, self-documenting model for these tokens. This will involve defining structured types for different token categories and ensuring type safety across your design system. By the end, you'll have a foundational model that can be extended and integrated into larger projects.
intro.usecase: A typed design tokens model is foundational in large-scale design systems used by companies like Shopify or Airbnb. Developers use it to enforce consistent spacing, colors, and typography across product dashboards, marketing sites, and mobile apps. For example, a dashboard's card components, modal overlays, and form inputs all rely on these tokens to maintain visual harmony and simplify theme switching. This approach prevents style bugs and speeds up UI development when building or updating features.
